Uncontrolled.description: EVs are charged at their rated charging power (with an optional cap) without implementing any charge control policy.

TOU ASAP.description: All EVs are charged (at rated power) as soon as possible only during the off-peak periods based on a TOU price tariff.

TOU ALAP.description: All EVs are charged (at rated power) as late as possible only during off-peak periods based on a TOU price tariff.

TOU Random.description: All EVs are charged (at rated power) only during off-peak periods based on a TOU price tariff with random charging start times to avoid concurrent charging overload.

FCFS.description:
EVs connected to the same service transformer are charged on a first-come, first-served basis to prevent transformer overloading. The first EV to connect receives a larger share of the available capacity, while subsequent EVs are allocated the remaining capacity in smaller portions.

Note: You need to upload AMI data for P and Q profiles.

FCFS + SM.description:
This controller option also follows the first-come, first-served principle, but it also ensures that all EVs receive a minimum average percentage of the available power capacity that can be adjusted using the slider below.

Note: You need to upload AMI data for P and Q profiles.

Equal Sharing.description:
The remaining transformer capacity will be distributed evenly among all connected EVs.

Note: You need to upload AMI data for P and Q profiles.
